subject: general
question: An angle greater than 180 degrees is referred to as ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __a reflex angle__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A reflex angle__ is an angle that measures greater than 180 degrees but less than 360 degrees.
 
• It is the largest type of angle that can be measured.
 
• For example, the angle formed by the hands of a clock at 10:10 is a reflex angle.
 
• Reflex angles are represented visually in geometry by the larger arc opposite to the smaller arc.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Right Angle:**

 
 
• A right angle is exactly 90 degrees.
 
• It is formed when two lines intersect perpendicularly.
 
 
 
• **Acute Angle:**
 
 
• An acute angle measures less than 90 degrees.
 
• It is smaller than a right angle.
 
 
 
• **Obtuse Angle:**
 
 
• An obtuse angle is greater than 90 degrees but less than 180 degrees.
 
• It is larger than a right angle but smaller than a straight angle.
